memory_update.text: KLA should remain the reference anchor for the process-control / inspection / metrology node, but not dominate the discovery lane because it is already a well-known leader.
Onto Innovation is a strong underfollowed candidate for AI-related advanced packaging inspection, 3D metrology, lithography, process-control software, and factory analytics exposure.
